body:
Your decision (31 Oct): Ieva stands by the stable and grooms the horses; you talk to her to borrow a horse; the first time she sends you to Stan at the jump field.
- Ieva brushes a horse with long strokes; the horse swishes its tail and turns its head to her.
- You walk up; she nods, then points to Stan; Stan waves.
The brush is a marked stand-in (asked Objects for a brush model). Pictures: the two lower cells.

comments.text:
Done: Ieva grooms a horse and points you to Stan (lower two pictures).
Brush is a stand-in until Objects makes one.

short: Ieva brushes a horse, points you to Stan. OK?
